subject: pkg/executor: refine the Executor interface (#49494)
summary:
Refactors internal `exec.Executor` to remove `Base()` and promote chunk allocation/runtime-stats/SQL-killer/TopSQL/children access onto the interface (implemented by `BaseExecutor`), then updates executor call sites mechanically.

Reviewed `exec.Next` wrapper semantics (SQLKiller + TopSQL registration + runtime stats), chunk allocation sites in index lookup/merge/join/coprocessor paths, and sys-session usage in admin checks; no Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn, concurrency, privilege/visibility, or protocol/runtime regressions found. Scanned later history on `upstream/master` for the touched core area; saw subsequent refactors but no evidence of a later fix addressing a high-severity regression introduced here.
